position.title: Screen Position
position.description: Where to display this module on the mirror screen.

interval.title: Update Interval (Seconds)
interval.description: Time to wait between feed updates (e.g. 600 = 10 minutes).

max_items.title: Max Headlines
max_items.description: Maximum number of news headlines to display.

show_preamble.title: Show Preamble
show_preamble.description: Show a brief summary description under the headline.

builtin_feeds.title: Built-in Feeds
builtin_feeds.description: Select from our list of pre-configured Swedish and International news feeds.

custom_feeds.title: Custom News Feeds
custom_feeds.description: Add your own XML RSS or Atom feed URLs.

name.title: Source Name
name.description: Friendly name of the news source (e.g., SVT Nyheter).

url.title: Feed URL
url.description: URL to the RSS or Atom XML feed.

width.title: Width (px)
width.description: Width of the news widget in pixels.

height.title: Height (px)
height.description: Height limit in pixels. Use 0 for no height limit (auto height).

scroll_overflow.title: Auto-scroll Overflow
scroll_overflow.description: Enable vertical auto-scrolling. Requires a height limit greater than 0.
